comment: The maker's four input names are spelled Moduulation in the source (StereoChorus.cpp:129-132), so that is what the tooltips read; the panel prints MODULATION. MODULATION inputs 2, 3 and 4 are polyphonic only in the sense that a second channel is read for the right side of that voice; further channels are ignored. The eight-channel mode belongs to input 1 alone and needs eight or more channels regardless of how many voices are selected.
